'''Balosar Outpost''' was an illegally constructed [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Balosar system/Legends|Balosar system]] acting as a staging point for assaults on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] territories. It was the site of a massive [[Battle of the Balosar system|battle]] involving all available Republic ships in an effort to disable the station.
